meta.title: removing unused imports generates invalid `use module_name::self`
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2024-05-20 and 2024-05-27; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2024-05-27. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: Removing the unused X from 'use super::inner::{self, X};' left the single-element tree {self}, whose braces were then removed as unnecessary, printing 'super::inner:self'. Attempt 1 (parse errors) did not see the wrong edit: the pre build writes 'use super::inner::self;', which parses; attempt 2 compares the edit with the fix's regression-test golden (specification probe).

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: verbatim with the cursor marker $0 removed
a library crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/lib.rs. With the cursor at the end of the use tree 'use super::inner::{self, X}' (line 7, character 31, the issue's $0) apply the assist that removes the unused imports. Reported: 'use super::inner:self;', which is invalid; expected 'use super::inner;'. Probe (specification, attempt 2): the edited src/lib.rs must equal the fix's regression-test golden for the issue's code, which keeps the braces: 'use super::inner::{self};'.

expected.source: crates/ide-assists/src/handlers/remove_unused_imports.rs@e3e22c67 (test remove_unused_fixes_nested_self, the issue's code: expected 'use super::inner::{self};')

attempts.summary: 'Remove all the unused imports' at the use tree, checked for new parse errors: not-reproduced-pre. The pre build 2024-05-20 did produce the wrong edit, but as 'use super::inner::self;' (two colons, not the reporter's 'inner:self'), which parses (rustc rejects it only in name resolution, E0429 'self imports are only allowed within a { } list', and rust-analyzer reports nothing); the post build 2024-05-27 produced 'use super::inner::{self};'. The parser-based probe cannot see this wrong edit.
